description: Invoices for one matter: total, balance, paid (balance 0), due date, last payment date. customer_match "confirmed" (manually linked) or "exact" (name match) means these invoices belong to the matter; "none"/"ambiguous" returns no invoices plus unconfirmed possible_customers. Does not create, send, or charge. Sign-in required.

matter_id.description: Matter identifier from find_matter or list_open_matters.
